profile.headline: Ex-Senior Web Developer @ Monks | Webflow Developer | Digital Marketing Strategist | Web Design | SEO/AEO & Content Strategy
profile.summary:
I’m a digital strategist and web developer with 5+ years of experience helping businesses elevate their online presence through high-performing websites, integrated marketing campaigns, and data-driven growth strategies.

In my recent role at Monks, I managed 15+ company domains and lead initiatives that went beyond development, including building digital content strategies, optimizing marketing and operations workflows, analyzing performance metrics, and driving measurable improvements in engagement, accessibility, and SEO/AEO. My background blends technical expertise (Webflow, HTML, CSS, automation) with marketing skills (social media strategy, email campaigns, analytics, branding), allowing me to bridge creative storytelling with performance insights. Adept in modern martech tooling such as GA4, GTM, GSC, CRM Software (Hubspot), CMP Software (OneTrust), Ahrefs, SEMrush, Zapier, and more. Trained in AI tooling with regular use of platforms such as Gemini, ChatGPT, and Claude.

With 15+ years of customer-facing and leadership experience, I bring strong collaboration, communication, and people-first skills to every project. I’m passionate about the outdoors, dogs, technology, keeping the web accessible, and community impact. I thrive in roles where technology, design, accessibility, sustainability, and authentic storytelling intersect.

If you’re looking for someone who can combine development skills with digital marketing strategy to grow your brand’s presence and engagement, let’s connect.

Primarily building in Webflow.

positions.title: Web Designer & Web Developer
positions.description: Creating responsive and intuitive websites in #Webflow to help grow your business; Whether that be a brick and mortar establishment, an e-commerce store, or a combination of the two. Collaborating with clients to refine ideas and develop a product that will aim to increase visitors, conversions to customers, social media presence, SEO, and in turn increase revenue for the client.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
Monks is the purely digital operating brand of S4Capital plc that connects 8,600+ digital natives across one global team. We're driven by a common goal: to shift industries forward and unlock ambitious outcomes for our clients and our people. By combining media, data, social, platforms, studio, experience, brand, and technology services, we help our clients continuously reinvent themselves throughout increasingly rapid cycles of disruption.

Monks Technology Services (formerly Formula.Monks/TheoremOne) is the tech pillar of Monks. We’re a global technology partner driving purposeful, AI-powered transformation for all aspects of enterprise organizations.   Our clients are household names and Fortune 100 companies: Walmart, Meta, CAT, Johnson & Johnson, Morningstar, and hundreds more. We work with the largest internal operations systems in the world, and we bring a level of enterprise expertise, long-term strategic thinking, and a human-centered approach to designing tech and AI solutions to transform our clients’ businesses.

Our efforts in shaping culture, building innovative technologies, and unlocking future growth have been recognized by esteemed panels, including Adweek's Fastest Growing lists(2019-22), regular recognition at Cannes Lions, inclusion in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players (2020-23), the title of Webby Production Company of the Year (2021-23), a record number of FWAs, and have earned a spot on Newsweek’s Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces 2023.

Join us in our journey towards continued digital innovation, craft excellence, and supporting the people who make it all happen Together, let's create the NOW.
